title: No client calls /api/apply/confirmation-email after signup after() fix
blast: Orphan public POST remains attack surface (rate-limited) and confuses ops about which path sends receipts.
evidence: rg '/api/apply/confirmation-email' across *.ts/*.tsx only hits the route itself and lib/rate-limit.ts prefixes — zero importers in app/ or components/. Apply signup now schedules sendApplicationConfirmationEmail via after() in app/api/apply/signup/route.ts:699.

title: Member eligibility route comment still documents fire-and-forget sends
blast: Comment lies after a fix or documents the bug if left unfixed — either way drifts from apply signup pattern.
evidence: app/api/member/eligibility/route.ts:254-255 comment '// Fire-and-forget confirmation to member + Mike/admin (WS5).' followed by bare sendEligibilityScreeningConfirmationEmail(...).catch without after().
